name: windows-deployment-builder
description: Local TypeScript generator for Windows 11 Pro autounattend.xml with Windows Update and WinGet provisioning engines and a USB deployment package

scripts.test:ps: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/powershell/Engine.Tests.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/powershell/UpdateRetry.Tests.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/powershell/Applications.Tests.ps1 && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/powershell/Migration.Tests.ps1 && vite-node tests/powershell/make-deployment-fixture.ts node_modules/.cache/wdd-fixture && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/powershell/Deployment.Tests.ps1 -Fixture node_modules/.cache/wdd-fixture && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/powershell/Monitor.Tests.ps1 -Fixture node_modules/.cache/wdd-fixture && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/powershell/Acl.Tests.ps1 -Fixture node_modules/.cache/wdd-fixture && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/powershell/Media.Tests.ps1 -Fixture node_modules/.cache/wdd-fixture && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/powershell/Drivers.Tests.ps1 -Fixture node_modules/.cache/wdd-fixture && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/powershell/Health.Tests.ps1 -Fixture node_modules/.cache/wdd-fixture && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/powershell/Office.Tests.ps1 -Fixture node_modules/.cache/wdd-fixture && vite-node tests/powershell/make-wifi-fixture.ts node_modules/.cache/wifi-fixture && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/powershell/Wifi.Tests.ps1 -Fixture node_modules/.cache/wifi-fixture && vite-node scripts/build-manager.ts --policy node_modules/.cache/app-manager-policy.json && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/powershell/AppManager.Tests.ps1 -Policy node_modules/.cache/app-manager-policy.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
